aida.name: AIDA Framework
aida.primary_text:
[ATTENTION: Hook question or bold statement]

[INTEREST: Expand on the problem/opportunity]

[DESIRE: Show the transformation/benefit]

[ACTION: Clear next step]
aida.headline: [Key Benefit in 5 words]

pas.name: PAS Framework
pas.primary_text:
[PROBLEM: Name the pain point directly]

[AGITATE: Make them feel the cost of not solving it]

[SOLUTION: Present your product as the answer]
pas.headline: [Solution in 5 words]

bab.name: BAB Framework
bab.primary_text:
[BEFORE: Describe current frustrating situation]

[AFTER: Paint the picture of life with solution]

[BRIDGE: Show how your product gets them there]
bab.headline: [Transformation promise]

social_proof.name: Social Proof Lead
social_proof.primary_text:
[NUMBER] [customers/users/businesses] already [RESULT].

[TESTIMONIAL or specific result]

[CTA: Join them / Start today]
social_proof.headline: [Result + timeframe]

direct_offer.name: Direct Offer
direct_offer.primary_text:
[OFFER: X% off / Free trial / Limited time]

[WHAT: Brief product description]

[WHY NOW: Urgency element]
direct_offer.headline: [Offer in 5 words]
